gloss: vacant lot; empty plot of land

definitions.gloss: vacant lot; empty plot of land; unused land
definitions.explanation: A piece of land that has no buildings or structures on it and is not being used for any particular purpose.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{空|あ}き{地|ち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: Children are playing in the vacant lot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{空|あ}き{地|ち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}つ→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧らしい。
examples.english: Apparently an apartment building is going to be built on the vacant lot in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{放置|ほうち}→放置：12826_houchi⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧{空|あ}き{地|ち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{雑草|ざっそう}→雑草：04996_zassou⟧⟦だらけ→〜だらけ：18372_darake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{苦情|くじょう}→苦情：00252_kujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The vacant lot that had been left unattended for years became overgrown with weeds, and complaints have come from the neighborhood.

notes:
USAGE:
{空|あ}き{地|ち} is a compound of ⟦{空|あ}き→空く：11062_aku⟧ (empty, vacant) and {地|ち} (land). In Japanese neighborhoods, vacant lots are often associated with childhood play and are a common setting in manga and anime.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空|あ}き{地|ち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧ (to play in a vacant lot)
- {空|あ}き{地|ち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧ (to make use of a vacant lot)
- {空|あ}き{地|ち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駐車|ちゅうしゃ}する→駐車する：22431_chuushasuru⟧ (to park on a vacant lot)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {空|あ}き{地|ち}: vacant lot (general, everyday)
- ⟦{更地|さらち}→更地：17562_sarachi⟧: cleared land, empty lot (ready for construction)
- ⟦{荒|あ}れ{地|ち}→荒れ地：20128_arechi⟧: wasteland, barren land (uncultivated, wild)
